# reBotArmController_ROS2 observations

Quan sát chính: repo này có ROS 2 packages, custom messages/actions/services, MoveIt config, bringup và ros2_control related files.

## Khái niệm rút ra

| Source signal | System foundation |
|---|---|
| `rebotarm_msgs/action` | ROS 2 action model |
| `rebotarm_msgs/srv` | service model |
| `rebotarm_moveit_config/config/kinematics.yaml` | kinematics solver concept |
| `ompl_planning.yaml` | planning pipeline/OMPL concept |
| `ros2_controllers.yaml` | ros2_control/controller concept |

::: callout-note
MoveIt 2 planning output cần execution interface. Đây là lý do phải học cả planning model lẫn controller model.
:::
